examples.target: Do you have any other symptoms, like pain in your chest?
I have had a fever and a bad cough for three days.
No pain, but I feel very weak and I cannot sleep well.
No, it is just a strong flu. You need to rest for at least five days.
How long will it take to recover completely?
About a week. Come back for another appointment if it gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Hello, please sit down. What brings you here today?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have had a fever and a bad cough for three days.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Do you have any other symptoms, like pain in your chest?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No pain, but I feel very weak and I cannot sleep well.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Let me listen to your lungs. Please breathe deeply.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: No, it is just a strong flu. You need to rest for at least five days.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: I will give you a prescription for the fever. Drink a lot of water, too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long will it take to recover completely?

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: About a week. Come back for another appointment if it gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you, doctor. I will follow your advice.
